dashboard.label: First Seen Tracking
dashboard.description: Entities appearing for the first time, tracked by hourly scheduled searches into per-entity KV store collections. Time picker filters by stored first_seen.

html.p: How this dashboard works: entities are tracked by hourly scheduled searches (Beelzebub - Tracker - * in savedsearches) and stored in beelzebub_first_seen_* KV store collections. The dashboard is empty until the first tracker run completes (within ~1 hour of install). Once populated, panels show entities whose first-ever sighting falls inside the selected time window.

search.query: | inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_source | eval _earliest = if(match("$time_range.earliest$", "^\d"), tonumber("$time_range.earliest$"), relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$")) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), if(match("$time_range.latest$", "^\d"), tonumber("$time_range.latest$"), relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"))) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | stats count
